_evidence: Menu item record read by 0x0054e8e7 and its wrappers 0x54e814/0x54e884 (edx = 0xd0/0xdf) and 0x54e8aa/0x54e8be ('cmp byte [0x7aafd3],0; je' then edx = 0xe8/0xee). 0x54e8e7: 'test byte [esi+0x1f],0x10; jne' (skip), words +4/+6/+8/+0xa loaded into ebx/eax/ebp/ecx (+6) and handed to 0x549db9 (stored in a pool node, never dereferenced: full u16), 'test [esi+0x1f],0x80|0x20' select the bumps, then 'mov ah,[esi+0xc]; cmp ah,[0x82fd45]; jne' compares the item id with the selection byte. The earlier specs drew every record byte from a flag set and left 0x82fd45 at its image value (or fuzzed), so the id matched the selection only by accident. Buffer part (esi, 0x40 bytes, random background): flag byte +0x1f from the flag set (0x10/0x20/0x80 combinations, zero twice), id +0xc from 1/2. Global part: the selection byte 0x82fd45 from 1/2 as well, so id == selection in about half the cases (menu ids and selections are 1-based, as in items_0053dc57), and 0x7aafd3 zero and nonzero for the two gated wrappers. Compose after list_00549db9 (the pool 0x549db9 inserts into).
